europe_now.title: Major Drone Strike Hits Crimea Bridge
europe_now.summary: Russia reports its largest Ukrainian drone attack of the war after the Crimean Bridge was struck. The strike damaged the arch of the key transport link between Crimea and Russia.

sources.headline: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
Ukraine damages Crimean Bridge, drones likely hit arch (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,726)

europe_now.title: EU Sanctions Russian Hackers and Propagandists Targeting Voters
europe_now.summary: The EU has imposed sanctions on Russian propagandists and hackers linked to thousands of fake accounts targeting voters. The measures address foreign interference in European democratic processes.

sources.headline: More EU sanctions on Russian propagandists and hackers, as thousands of fake accounts target voters

top_stories.title: Ukraine Strikes Crimea Bridge in Large Drone Attack
top_stories.summary: Ukraine has struck the Crimean Bridge in what Russia describes as its largest drone attack of the war. The attack damaged the arch of the structure linking Crimea to Russia.

sources.headline: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
Ukraine damages Crimean Bridge, drones likely hit arch (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,726)

top_stories.title: EU Imposes Sanctions on Russian Disinformation Actors
top_stories.summary: The European Union has sanctioned Russian propagandists and hackers involved in online disinformation campaigns. Thousands of fake accounts have been used to target voters across Europe.

sources.headline: More EU sanctions on Russian propagandists and hackers, as thousands of fake accounts target voters

top_stories.title: Czech Protests Target Government Media Funding Plan
top_stories.summary: Thousands of demonstrators have gathered in Prague to oppose changes to public media funding. Protesters argue the plan threatens media independence and democracy.

sources.headline: Czech mass protests: Media is the first casualty 'when you want to attack democracy'
Prague: Thousands of Czechs rally against government media funding plan

top_stories.title: Five EU Countries Plan Rwanda Migrant Return Centre
top_stories.summary: Five EU countries have announced a plan to send failed asylum-seekers to a return centre in Rwanda. Key details of the partnership remain secret and no formal deal has been signed.

sources.headline: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda

top_stories.title: Draft COP31 Text Proposes Immediate Fossil Fuel Exit
top_stories.summary: A draft climate agreement for COP31 calls for an immediate phase-out of fossil fuels. European negotiators are seeking consensus on the contentious proposal.
